name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_get_selected_profile_values
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::GetSelectedProfileValues returns writable buffers for the selected profile player name and connect string and copies the selected connect-string mode.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x441c60 validates reading m_selectedProfileIndex at offset 0x114, calling CString::GetBuffer(32) on m_profilePlayerNames[selected] at offset 0xfc and m_profileConnectStrings[selected] at offset 0x104, storing those pointers into the first two out parameters, and copying m_profileConnectStringModes[selected] from offset 0x10c into the third out parameter.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_get_selected_profile_values_smoke initializes selected profile index 1, assigns player/connect strings and mode values, and verifies the out parameters match the selected profile fields.
